open-store-app.note: opening a store's chain app (the app key in a linked store's section header with its one-time tip, the store screen's app card and chain row, chains suggested while naming a store, Ist das ...? for a saved chain name, the list's card asking about existing stores) shows only while the PostHog flag open-store-app is on (job 313); off until Legal answers on chain names without a trademark line

input-stable-rows.note: the add sheet's rows stay put while typing (made on the device on every key with a category guess, the server's rows merged in below without moving them, none changes under a finger) and a new grocery without a remembered store goes to the store the household uses most for its category, only while the PostHog flag input-stable-rows is on (job 272)

on-device-catalog.note: the add sheet's rows ranked on the device in the same frame as the key (the bundled catalog with the server's daily changes, the household's suggest_index fetched on each resync), the server's answer only enriching them, only while the PostHog flag on-device-catalog is on (job 274)

add-feedback-list.note: while the add sheet is open the list behind it shows its items without store and category headings and ends in a Just added section with each add, and slides back into stores and categories when the sheet closes; after an add the sheet shows the item's details (amount, brand, details, store, category) until the next letter, store and category in its one sideways line, the list's top bar away while the sheet is open (job 288); a thin line above the field while suggestions load, older ones dimmed; only while the PostHog flag add-feedback-list is on (job 276)

add-sheet-compact.note: AS1, the compact add sheet on top of add-feedback-list (no close key, only the grab handle; after an add no Added note or Undo but one row of chips for amount, store, category and details, whose options fold out as one sideways line; the sheet as tall as its content; the list behind it only the last two adds; a swipe down, a tap beside it, the back key or Enter in the empty field closes it) shows only while the PostHog flag add-sheet-compact is on (job 322); on for Peter and the testers

add-match-rows.note: AM2, the add sheet's match rows on top of add-sheet-compact (while typing, the items already on the list that are the same thing, also as a plural or a synonym, show as rows: merge into the open one, tick it off, or put a ticked one back on the list, each one tap; the + row and Enter add the typed item separately next to an open one, and Enter puts a ticked one back) shows only while the PostHog flag add-match-rows is on (job 324)

display-name.note: the name step after sign-in (Wie sollen wir dich nennen?, prefilled from Google or Apple, required before a household is created or joined, once with Jetzt nicht for members whose name is still their e-mail prefix) and Konto > Dein Name show only while the PostHog flag display-name is on (job 297)

report-content-entry.note: reporting content in the app (More's feedback row says Also: report content; Feedback & ideas, or without FB4 the feedback form opened from More, has Report content, which opens the report form with Legal's B.4 texts, its picker of the household's items, lists and name or somewhere else, an optional covered screenshot with feedback-fb2, and the confirmation with the report's number) shows only while the PostHog flag report-content-entry is on (job 281); off until Legal's hash-bound GO on the B.3 to B.8 texts (N-226)

rating-triggers-v2.note: the store rating prompt's trip moments (ST1: after leaving the summary of a finished trip with everything planned bought; ST2: after an emptied list answered Nein, nur abgehakt; no ask while a trip runs, after an undo of the emptying, a failed trip save, a join or household switch, or within 14 days of a bug note; at most 2 asks a year, 180 days apart) apply only while the PostHog flag rating-triggers-v2 is on (job 326); off, the prompt keeps job 155's emptied-list moment

hide-categories.note: categories leave what users see only while the PostHog flag hide-categories is on (job 350): no category headings in the list (also trip mode, Zuletzt verwendet and the add sheet's list), no category chip or picker in the add sheet and the edit sheet, no category order on the store screens and no hint about it; the order stays (categories sort underneath); on for internal installs (Peter and the internal tester group) only
